summary: Frontend-only test of the simplified Boat Inventory Set Up wizard (test-user-beta / main, desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844). PASS: screen 1 fields, new hint, Next disabled until type/make/model/year filled; no web schematic search (only GET /blank-*.png + POST zone-maps); 'Getting your blank schematic...' then 'Your blank schematic'; right blank used for each type (Catamaran: 2 hulls, Trimaran: 3, Yacht - Sloop: monohull 580x203); Galley screen order (text, Galley chip only, plan, Back/Next), Next disabled with 'Tap the Galley on the drawing first' until tapped, tick on the chip, tapping again moves the dot (still one), no Skip/checkboxes; Cockpit: only the Cockpit chip, later/now checkboxes act like radio buttons (later is default -> Finish, now -> Next), Skip This (later -> finishes, now -> Nav Station); Finish closes the wizard, opens Boat Inventory zone map with the placed zones, toast about usual cupboards (13 cupboards created incl. Fridge/Freezer), ZoneTipDialog, and after 'Got it' the Galley swatch+label get mbp-glow (amber ring); Nav Station: only the 'now' checkbox (ticked) + Skip This, untick -> Finish, Skip This -> Heads; Heads chips exactly the 6 expected; Cabins chips exactly the 9 expected (no Cabin Top / Stateroom); Engines: 3 chips, no checkbox, no Skip, Finish; multi-colour arming text 'Now tap the drawing where the Forward Head is.' and several heads placed; each Back goes one step back (Galley Back -> screen 1); own overview schematic: title 'Your schematic', no blank fetch/upload; screen 1 skipped when all details filled; mobile: blank 680px wide inside a scrollable 360px box, scroll hint shown, buttons/checkboxes fit within 390px. FAIL (1 bug): when the wizard skips screen 1 (all details filled) and the boat already has its own schematic, the Galley chip is NOT pre-armed, so tapping the drawing only shows 'Tap a colour first, then tap the drawing' (reproduced 2/2).

ui_bugs.issue: armed is set only once by useState(colours.length === 1 ? colours[0].label : null) when the panel first appears. When the wizard opens straight on the Galley step (details already filled + boat has its own overview schematic), /api/zone-colour-presets hasn't come back yet, so colours=[] at that point and armed stays null after the Galley chip appears. Tapping the drawing does nothing except show the toast 'Tap a colour first, then tap the drawing', and the chip has no ring. The user has to tap the Galley chip first (that works). The blank flow isn't affected because the upload takes longer than the presets fetch, but the same race could happen on a slow network. Fix: add useEffect(() => { if (colours.length === 1) setArmed(colours[0].label); }, [colours.length]) in ZoneTapPanel, or key the panel on `${step}-${colours.length}`, or wait for the presets before going to a tap step.

design_issues.screen: Wizard reopened after a blank was already uploaded
issues: The title says 'Your schematic' (blank=false) and the mobile wide-scroll layout and 'The bow is on the right.' hint are dropped, even though the map is the blank drawing.

If the user goes back to screen 1 and changes the boat type (e.g. Catamaran -> Trimaran) after a blank was uploaded, the old blank is reused (go() finds the existing overview), so the blank no longer matches the type.

The blank drawing opens scrolled to the stern (left edge) with the bow off-screen. This is acceptable given the scroll hint. The 'Your blank schematic' title wraps to 2 lines and is centred, while the body text is left-aligned (cosmetic).

action_items: Pre-arm the single chip in ZoneTapPanel once the presets arrive (useEffect on colours.length) so the Galley can be tapped straight away when screen 1 is skipped or presets load slowly.

Optional: keep the 'blank' state when reopening the wizard on a blank map (e.g. flag the map as blank, or compare the image name), and replace the blank when the boat type changes on screen 1 and the blank has no swatches yet.
critical_code_review_comments: InventorySetupWizard: 'blank' is only in component state, so reopening the wizard loses the blank title, the big layout and the bow hint.
InventorySetupWizard.go(): reuses any existing overview, including a blank for a different boat type picked earlier.

Heads/Cabins/Nav show MoreZones with only the 'now' tick; unticking it on Heads/Cabins also gives Finish. This matches the spec, but Skip This on those screens silently re-ticks 'now' (setMore(true)). Intentional, but could surprise the user.

Reset between runs: DELETE each zone map via the API, then mongo user_boats {owner_id:'test-user-beta',boat_id:'main'} $set areas:[], zone_maps:[].
